nodes.name: Webhook Trigger
nodes.notes: Expects: { reviewerName, reviewText, rating, businessName, businessType }

messages.content:
You are writing a professional, warm reply to a Google review for {{ $json.businessName }} ({{ $json.businessType }}).

Reviewer name: {{ $json.reviewerName }}
Rating: {{ $json.rating }} stars
Review text: {{ $json.reviewText }}

Write a reply that:
- Starts by thanking the reviewer by first name
- Acknowledges specific points they mentioned
- For 4-5 star reviews: express genuine gratitude and invite them back
- For 1-3 star reviews: apologize sincerely, take responsibility, offer to make it right, provide contact info (info@bizautomatrix.com)
- Keeps the tone professional, human, and not robotic
- Stays under 100 words
- Does NOT include subject lines, greetings like 'Dear', or sign-offs like 'Regards'

Return only the reply text, nothing else.

setup: 1. Import this JSON into n8n (Workflows → Import)
2. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY as an n8n environment variable
4. Call the webhook with POST body: { reviewerName, reviewText, rating, businessName, businessType }
5. The webhook returns: { reply: '...generated reply...', reviewerName, rating }
_readme.model: Uses claude-haiku-4-5 (fast + cheap). Upgrade to claude-sonnet-4-6 for higher quality replies.
_readme.usage: Can be triggered from admin portal when a new review comes in. Admin reviews the AI reply, edits if needed, then posts to Google Business Profile manually or via GBP API.
